fields.statement: At 3a7069c4 the diff adds to internal/guide/text/plan-review.md a paragraph having the reviewer run `rhiza overlaps --change <cs> --json` for each plan change set and record each contradicting overlap as a `contradiction` finding naming the other change set; TestPlanReviewText in internal/guide/plan_test.go now asserts the phrases "rhiza overlaps --change <cs> --json" and "naming the other change set" beside "contradiction". go test ./internal/guide -count=1 -v: TestPlanReviewText, TestCaps and TestCapCatchesOversize PASS (plan-review 566 tokens, cap 800). make fmt-check vet test pass for every package. `rhiza overlaps --change` is accepted (overlaps.txtar exercises it). make self-check fails only on unrendered run actor records and index.md, which come from run entries outside this commit.
